corrections.reason: With A=(-1,0), B=(1,0), and theta=pi/2+delta (delta→0−), P approaches B and BM=cos(theta), OQ=cot(theta). Thus BM−OQ=cos(theta)(1−1/sin(theta))=delta^3/2+o(delta^3), so the quotient is +1/2. The pre-comparison freeze recorded −1/2 due to a sign error; original freeze is preserved.
